content:
Generate your main character first in Midjourney Niji V8.1, then reuse that image to build a character reference sheet to maintain character consistency across the full video.

In Midjourney, use explicit negatives and constraints (e.g., --no extra arms/extra fingers/text/logo/watermark and “one spear only”) to prevent unwanted anatomy, props, and artifacts in character designs.

Create a 16:9 landscape character reference sheet in GPT Image 2 by attaching the original character image and stating “REFERENCE PRIORITY: Use Image A as the absolute highest-priority identity reference” to lock face/outfit/weapon consistency.

In the GPT Image 2 reference-sheet prompt, specify a production model-sheet layout (front/side/back + 3/4 hero pose + face expression row + weapon/costume callouts + color palette swatches) to standardize the character for animation.

Generate a storyboard in GPT Image 2 and then animate the storyboard frames in VivaReel Video 2.0 as the final step.

Genera primero tu personaje principal en Midjourney Niji V8.1, luego reutiliza esa imagen para construir una hoja de referencia del personaje y mantener la consistencia del personaje a lo largo del video completo.

En Midjourney, utiliza negativos explícitos y restricciones (por ejemplo, --no extra arms/extra fingers/text/logo/watermark y “one spear only”) para evitar anatomías, accesorios y artefactos no deseados en los diseños de personajes.

Crea una hoja de referencia de personaje en formato apaisado 16:9 en GPT Image 2 adjuntando la imagen original del personaje y declarando “REFERENCE PRIORITY: Use Image A as the absolute highest-priority identity reference” para asegurar la consistencia de rostro/atuendo/arma.

En el prompt de la hoja de referencia de GPT Image 2, especifica un diseño de hoja de modelo de producción (vista frontal/lateral/trasera + pose de héroe 3/4 + fila de expresiones faciales + detalles de arma/vestuario + muestras de paleta de colores) para estandarizar el personaje para la animación.

Genera un storyboard en GPT Image 2 y luego anima los cuadros del storyboard en VivaReel Video 2.0 como paso final.

[Hilo 1] Primero, genero un personaje usando Midjourney Niji V8.1. Se utilizará como el personaje principal en esta película de 15 segundos, luego se usará para hacer la hoja de referencia del personaje para mantener la consistencia a lo largo del filme.

[Hilo 2] Luego adjunta la imagen anterior, genera una hoja de referencia de personaje en GPT Image 2

Aquí está el prompt que uso:
Create one single 16:9 LANDSCAPE CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET for an original cinematic anime heroine.

REFERENCE PRIORITY:
Use Image A as the absolute highest-priority identity reference for the character’s face structure, mature serious expression, short wet side-swept dark ash hair, slim athletic body, dark tactical rain coat, shoulder armor, black fitted combat suit, long vertical spear, storm rooftop mood, rain, and white lightning halo motif.

CHARACTER NAME:
C1 — THE STORM LANCER

ROLE LINE:
A lone rooftop fighter who catches lightning and turns it into a white electric spear.

CORE IDENTITY:
Young adult female storm warrior, calm but dangerous, battle-worn, emotionally restrained, not cute, not childish, not glamorous. She feels like a survivor of a dead city storm, elegant but grounded.

REFERENCE SHEET LAYOUT:
Professional anime production model sheet layout on a clean muted gray / off-white background.
Include:
1. Full-body front view, neutral standing pose
2. Full-body side view
3. Full-body back view
4. 3/4 hero pose holding the spear vertically
5. Close-up face expression row: calm, focused, wounded determination, cold anger
6. Weapon detail panel: long dark metal spear with bright white lightning core and minimalist spearhead
7. Costume detail callouts: high collar rain coat, shoulder armor plates, chest harness, belt, gloves, knee boots, torn coat hem
8. Color palette swatches: charcoal black, storm gray, dark steel, wet ash blue, pure white lightning

CHARACTER DESIGN LOCK:
Keep the same mature female face, sharp eyes, serious mouth, short messy wet hair covering part of the forehead, subtle dirt and scratches on the face, slim athletic proportions, long black tactical coat with torn lower hem, dark armored shoulders, black fitted bodysuit, tactical belt, fingerless gloves, armored boots, and single long spear.

WEAPON LOCK:
One spear only. The spear is tall, dark, minimalist, and elegant. It must have a glowing pure white electric energy core. White lightning crawls around the shaft and spearhead. No sword, no saber, no gun, no extra weapon.

VFX MOTIF:
White lightning halo behind the character, thin electric arcs around the spear, subtle rain mist glow, storm-energy patterns on the coat edge. The halo should feel like controlled lightning geometry, not angel wings.

STYLE:
Premium cinematic anime realism, dark sci-fi fantasy character design, semi-realistic anime face, painterly anime concept art, high detail but clean readable silhouette, production-ready design sheet, consistent proportions across all views, dramatic but not overdecorated, realistic wet fabric and armor texture, stormy atmospheric lighting.

BACKGROUND:
Clean neutral production sheet background with very subtle rain/storm texture. Do not show a full movie scene. Do not show a rooftop environment except as tiny atmospheric texture behind the hero pose.

IMPORTANT:
This is a character reference sheet, not a poster, not a storyboard, not a final film still. Keep all views consistent. Keep the outfit readable. Keep the face recognizable from Image A. Keep the character adult and serious.
